items.comment: Note 16 subsequent events: first senior secured debt facility of approximately $775m entered into on July 10, 2026.

fragments.text: On March 20, 2026, the Group completed an offering, pursuant to Rule 144A under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, of $4.34 billion aggregate original principal amount of senior unsecured convertible notes (the “March 2026
The net proceeds to the Company from the sale of March 2026 Notes were $4,293.7.

The Company had previously issued convertible notes in an aggregate original principal amount of $4.16 billion in June 2025 and September 2025, which accrete to an aggregate principal amount at maturity of $4,86 billion.

items.comment: Document (6-K of 12 Aug 2026) predates the August 2026 convertible offering; the latest issuance disclosed is the March 2026 notes ($4.34bn), with no $5.75bn August 2026 notes.

fragments.text: They are senior unsecured obligations of the Company and rank pari passu with all of the Company’s other existing and future senior unsecured indebtedness.
The facility is collateralized by deployed GPU infrastructure and by contracted cash flows arising under a customer agreement with an investment-grade counterparty.

items.comment: No financial maintenance covenant (ratio test) is disclosed anywhere in the document: the convertible notes are described only by indenture terms and the secured facility only by collateral and pricing.

fragments.text: As of June 30, 2026, the amount of unsatisfied RPO was $37,490.6, of which 36% is expected to be recognized as revenue during the 24 months ending June 30, 2028, 40% between months 25 and 48, and the remainder recognized thereafter.
The amounts are fully attributed to the Group’s Nebius AI cloud business.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Contractual backlog backing the customer prepayments in deferred revenue is disclosed, with the near-term recognition profile.

new_facts.topic: NVIDIA equity investment via pre-funded warrants

fragments.text: On March 11, 2026 the Company entered into a securities purchase agreement with NVIDIA to issue Pre-Funded Warrants to purchase 21,065,936 Class A ordinary shares (“Pre-Funded Warrant Shares”) for aggregate gross proceeds of $2,000.0.

new_facts.why_it_matters: A strategic supplier also supplied equity, adding a non-debt funding channel alongside the convertible notes.

fragments.text: During the three months ended June 30, 2026, the Company sold 12,729,493 Class A shares under the ATM program at a weighted-average price of $223.60 per share before issuance costs.
As of June 30, 2026, 12,270,507 Class A shares remained available for offer and sale under the ATM program.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Equity issuance capacity is another funding source for AI infrastructure, alongside the secured facility and converts.

new_facts.topic: Energy and power supply commitments (off balance sheet)

fragments.text: As of June 30, 2026, expected future fixed or minimum guaranteed commitments under these agreements amounted to $81.7 in 2026, $541.8 in 2027, $542.0 in 2028, $540.5 in 2029, $535.8 in 2030, and $3,082.3 thereafter.

The Group has contractual obligations arising from contracts with remaining terms greater than one year, primarily consisting of energy and power supply agreements, related to the co-location arrangements and the development of greenfield data center facilities.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Fixed power and co-location commitments add contracted cash obligations on top of the disclosed lease and debt payments.
